title: Sunday · the empty dock
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Gully's dock in May with nobody on it. The lawn chair. The steps. The pup, alone, at the dock's end, looking at the water. The fourth Sunday of the empty town.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock from the shack steps in May light, empty: the lawn chair, the coiled hose, the pup sitting at the very end looking out.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a wooden dock seen from shack steps in May light with an old lawn chair, a coiled hose and a small three-legged dog sitting alone at the far end looking out at the water, no words

panels.name: Dock

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lawn chair, close, the webbing gone gray, a coffee ring on the arm.

panels.composition: Tier 3: the water off the dock's end, the pup's ears at the bottom edge. Held.
